Contact: john.reynolds@pinnaclewealth.com | +91-98200-12345 Professional Summary
Results-driven financial advisor specializing in high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) and NRIs. Manages $500M+ AUM with a focus on diversified portfolios, tax optimization, and retirement planning. Expert in volatile markets, blending traditional finance with fintech innovations for sustainable growth. Career Highlights

Pinnacle Wealth Partners (2020–Present): Built NRI-focused advisory practice; achieved 18% average annual returns for clients (2021–2025). Led digital transformation with robo-advisory tools. HDFC Bank Private Banking (2015–2020): Senior Advisor for UHNW clients; grew portfolio by 250% through customized ESOP and real estate strategies. ICICI Prudential AMC (2011–2015): Portfolio Manager; outperformed Nifty 50 benchmark by 12% annually with hybrid funds.

Early Career (2009–2011): Analyst at KPMG, specializing in financial audits and risk assessment. Key Skills & Expertise Investment Strategies: Equity, fixed income, alternatives (REITs, gold); ESG investing. Tools & Platforms: Bloomberg Terminal, Morningstar, Zerodha Kite; Python for portfolio analytics. Planning: Tax harvesting (India/US), estate planning, EPF/NPS optimization. Compliance: SEBI-registered RIA; FATCA/CRS expert for cross-border wealth.

Client Focus: Behavioral finance coaching; 95% client retention rate. Education & Certifications CFP (Certified Financial Planner), FPSB India (2014). CFA Level III Charterholder (2013). MBA, Finance, SP Jain Institute (2009). B.Com, Accounting, University of Mumbai (2007). Notable Achievements Recognition: Top 10 Financial Advisors, Dalal Street Awards (2024). Publication: "NRI Wealth Management in a Post-Pandemic World" (Economic Times blog, 2023).

Milestone: Advised 50+ unicorn founders on IPO liquidity events. Personal Interests
Marathon runner (Mumbai Marathon qualifier), wine enthusiast, mentors finance students at NMIMS, supports financial literacy NGOs
